newsitem.title: USA: Port Authority NY-NJ plans $1.2 bln bond sale.
newsitem.headline: Port Authority NY-NJ plans $1.2 bln bond sale.

text.p: The Port Authority of New York and New Jersey on Thursday said that it planned to sell in the first quarter as much as $1.2 billion of bonds for a new international arrivals building at John F. Kennedy Airport.

The sale initially was planned for December, but was delayed due to the project's complexity. "All relatively complicated, large-scale financial transactions are subject to delay. The December time-frame was overally optimistic," said a spokesman for the Authority.
